title: 2024 Porsche 911 S/T
summary: 2024 Porsche 911 S/T A Rare Modern Classic
description:
TOYZ autoart is pleased to bring you this 2024 Porsche 911 S/T A Rare Modern Classic

Offered here is an exceptional 2024 Porsche 911 S/T, one of the most focused and sought-after modern 911s. Created to celebrate the 60th anniversary of the 911, the S/T combines the naturally aspirated 4.0-liter flat-six from the GT3 RS with the six-speed manual transmission from the GT3 Touring, wrapped in an exceptionally lightweight package.

With its lightweight construction, rear-wheel drive, manual gearbox, high-revving engine, and unmistakable S/T character, this is a Porsche built for the enthusiast who values driver involvement above all else.

The S/T represents a rare combination of Porsche engineering and old-school sports-car philosophy: no unnecessary theatrics, just an extraordinarily responsive chassis, a thrilling naturally aspirated engine, and a manual transmission that makes every drive an occasion.

## Key highlights

- 4.0L naturally aspirated flat-six
- 518 hp
- 6-speed manual transmission
- Lightweight construction
- Rear-wheel drive
- GT3 RS-derived engine
- Limited-production S/T model
- 60th-anniversary 911 heritage

Whether displayed in a collection or exercised as Porsche intended, the 911 S/T is a special car from a very special era of Porsche GT engineeringa modern collectible that delivers an exceptionally analog driving experience.

title: 2020 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1
summary: Exclusive 1 of 1 ZL1 build with hundreds of hours & thousands of dollars invested. This one of a kind ZL1 has nearly too many upgrades to list. The 1,200 horsepower engine setup was a collaboration with Procharger Superchargers & Advanced Modern…
description: TOYZ autoart is pleased to bring you this exclusive 1 of 1 ZL1 build with hundreds of hours & thousands of dollars invested. This one of a kind ZL1 has nearly too many upgrades to list. The 1,200 horsepower engine setup was a collaboration with Procharger Superchargers & Advanced Modern Performance out of Texas with software programming by HP tuners & Uptown Autosport. New heads and Cam Package was installed to achieve these horsepower figures. A methanol injection kit is also on board. The massive brakes are Carbon Ceramic discs by Brembo which are shared on the Corvette ZR1. The wheels are custom 20 inch HRE Forged Wheels made exclusively for this build wrapped in Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 tires with a massive 345/25/20 rear tire. The interior was completely reupholstered in Lamborghini Blue Amon factory leather that can be found in the Urus. The door panels were sanded down including the upper dash and were refinished in exterior gloss black body colour. The widebody has added 8 inches in width to accommodate the 12.5 wide rear wheels. Suspension is KWs variant 3 adjustable coil overs kit. The entire vehicle is wrapped in clear paint protection film to keep the gloss black finish in showroom condition for many years to come.
